agentEnv.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
agentEnv.description: Google Gemini API key (AI Studio, generativelanguage.googleapis.com) for a triage/chat run against a real model, when a change needs one. In this repo Bifrost fronts every model and the environment does not start it: `docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d bifrost`, then put the key on Bifrost's `gemini` provider — through Settings → AI Config with provider type gemini, or directly: POST /api/providers {"provider":"gemini","keys":[]}, then POST /api/providers/gemini/keys with the key as `value` and `models: ["*"]` (an empty models list routes nothing). Address models as gemini/<id> and use the alias `gemini/gemini-flash-latest` (or `gemini-flash-lite-latest` for the cheapest): it resolves to the current flash model, where a versioned id typed from memory is usually retired or several generations behind, and Google has already withdrawn `gemini-2.5-flash` from new keys. This is not a Vertex credential: the seeded `vertex` provider needs a GCP service account the factory does not hold, so do not route through it or shim it.
